description: Create a VSCode debug configuration file at .vscode/launch.json for a FastAPI application. The configuration must be named 'FastAPI Debug' and include: (1) environment variable DATABASE_URL set to 'postgresql://localhost/testdb', (2) command-line arguments '--config config.yaml --port 8080', (3) Python interpreter path pointing to the virtual environment at .venv/bin/python or ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python, (4) program or module set to 'app.py' or '${workspaceFolder}/app.py'. The file must be valid JSON with a 'configurations' array containing this debug configuration. Workspace location: /home/ga/workspace/fastapi_project
